document:8:531:0.text:
First, carefully extract the essence of <style="highlight">tearleaves</style> over low heat, and grind <style="highlight">moonlight moss</style> into a luminous powder. Next, blend the tearleaf essence into the base solvent before gradually adding the moonlight moss powder. Stir gently until the mixture takes on a silver glow and stabilizes.
Caution: This is an alchemical product. Do not ingest or allow direct contact with skin or eyes.
document:8:531:0.source_cn:
此药剂需先以文火小心萃取<style="highlight">凝泪草</style>的锁水精华，再将<style="highlight">月光苔</style>研磨成荧光的粉末；炼制时，须先将凝泪草精华融入基础溶剂中浸润，再缓缓调入月光苔粉末，并缓慢搅拌至银光内敛、液体凝稳为止。
请注意，本品为炼金工艺制品，严禁食用或直接接触皮肤与眼部。
